To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example, pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in. Split four ways as usual, that is £1,271.75 each for me, Jan, Pete and Carol. It has gone up again by nearly £350 on last year. There is nothing I can do about that, the park sets the fees.

Please can everyone pay me by 31 January into the same account as before, as the park wants the full amount by then. If anyone would rather pay in two lots that is fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January, as long as it is all with me by 31 January.

The weeks are as follows. Pete and Linda have May half term, 29 May to 5 June. Me and Bev have 5 to 12 June, with handover on 5 June. Jan has 7 to 14 August for the grandkids. Carol has Easter week and a week in September as requested. There are no clashes this year.

Pete, the shower tray is sorted. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. It was £140 for parts but I am not putting that on the bill, it is done now.

Please can everyone remember to turn the water off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned about it again.

One other thing for 2028. The park says caravans over 15 years old will need a condition survey before that season. The van is 16 year old now so that will apply to us. I am mentioning it now so nobody is surprised when it comes up.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
